quote: We also have our dream of a Garden: but it lies in a distant future. We dream that woman shall eat of the tree of knowledge together with man, and that side by side and hand close to hand, through ages of much toil and labour, they shall together raise about them an Eden nobler than any the Chaldean dreamed of; an Eden created by their own labour and made beautiful by their own fellowship.
source: Olive Schreiner, Woman and Labour, ch. VI, Certain Objections, the closing pages (T. Fisher Unwin, 1911)
